Gauge.Name: VSTOL Controller, IPC
Gauge.Comment:
This gauge emulates a VTOL controller for Dino Cateneo's F35B.
V30.0_MSFS - For Dino's F35B (removed IRIS flaps stuff and new init parameters). - For Tailhook animation of fan/nozzle doors.
V30.1 - Change in STOL V/S settings; also solved VTOL-to-STOL transition problem. - Corrected the animation problem (framerate-dependant) when exiting STOVL mode. (removed the Tailhook delay)
V30.2 - When full throttle is set, it's actually 89 percent (to avoid afterburner sound) - During STOL, throttle is maximised to 90% - Nozzle swing during STOL reduced a bit for better visual alignment - Nozzle swing in STOL also elevator-dependant (visible IRL eg at carrier liftoff) - Target speed during STOL now non-lineair. - DECELL mode implemented (stronger decelleration when Hover mode is switched on)
V30.3: Does not exist
V30.4: - Now using Accel var for Tailhook Handle instead of own derivate. NOTE: (A:SurfaceRelativeGroundSpeed,knots) still unusable, since it's always positive (even when going backward). - Autothrust var now Off when Tailhook is retracted in mode-2 on the ground. - AP-Master is now also forced off in mode-1 - Increased max speed in VTOL to 50 knots.
V30.5: (for Beta2) - When going into Hover mode, the Target Groundspeed is set to the speed of a tracked carrier, if any.
V30.6: - Slower nozzle at low speed and delayed CTOL transition - Lower TargetSpeed in FINAL state to avoid funny display in MDF
V30.7: - Solved groundspeed bug on moving surfaces - Removed Init test with NoSmoking var
V30.8: - Improved groundspeed handling: - Speedchange smoothing now based on rudder/aileron input, for moving carriers. - Faster acceleration in VTO - Reversed the elevator-dependant nozzle movement. - In STOL, in nozzle animation formula, Throttle is limited to 90 to prevent "jitter" - Nozzle moves a bit faster - Added control for nozzle roll - Added control for airspeed-dependant LiftFanIntake angle
V30.9: - Added Lvar (L:InnerBayDoors,number).
V30.10: - Again, improved groundcontrol. - Tweaked InnerBayDoors var.
V30.11: - Max VTOL weight now 40600
V30.12/13: Obsolete
V30.14: - Now using FSX variables (A:STATIC CG TO GROUND,feet) and (A:STATIC PITCH,degrees) to dynamically determine GroundRH and GroundPitch. - Improved, weight-dependant STOL takeoff/landing (45 - 85 Knots, at resp 35000 - 60000 lbs). - Improved, airspeed-dependant decelleration in STOL config.
V30.15 - New elevator/aileron control in STOL flight mode - New Hover thrust at low alt.
V30.16 For V3 FDE: airspeed dependant pitch correction to compensate pitchup tendency
